messages:
Amy C: Quick sync — prelaunch staging playlist for the marketplace + joint GTM with HW partner and SI. Need: landing page final, press embargo, marketplace SKU mapping, SI integration checklist, and partner promo codes. Who owns what? :wave:

Raj P: I can own SI readiness. Status: end-to-end test passing except tenant-wide SSO. Raising a ticket for the SAML cert rotation.

Lisa M: Landing page copy is in Figma -> https://redwood.app/figma/marketplace-landing. Waiting on final hero image from Design (Mark said vendor will deliver today).

Mark S: Vendor creative ETA today noon PST. Legal still needs to approve the co-branding badge. @Legal-Jane can you confirm timeline?

Legal-Jane: I can review the badge by 4pm PT. Need the high-res PNG and the partner trademark brief.

Sophie L: Scheduling dry run for staging cutover + press rehearsal tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: deploy, marketplace listing, promo activation, press embargo test. @PressOps Bot add to calendar?

PressOps Bot: Added event "Marketplace launch dry run" — tomorrow 10:00 PT. Reminder set 30m prior. Embargo window note: 48 hours.

Amy C: Checklist snippet (copy/paste):
```
- Landing page live path: /marketplace/redwood-partner
- Blog draft: shared/doc/marketplace-announcement.md (PR open)
- SKU mapping: azure:sku-123 / aws:marketplace-456
- SI runbook: docs/si-onboard-checklist.md
- Promo codes: partner-REDWOOD-25 (QA needed)
- Legal badge approval: pending
- Embargo: 48h
```

Raj P: On SSO: created ticket INF-5423, assigned to eng-sso. ETA EOD tomorrow for cert rotation. If delayed, we'll toggle partner onboarding flag to manual.

Lisa M: Blog draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketplace-announcement-draft (comments welcome). Can someone own final review? Preferably @Amy C or @Mark S.

Mark S: I can do a content pass after Legal signs off. Also confirming the hardware SKU bundling: vendor wants to include "Redwood Accelerated" badge on product page — need to confirm verbiage.

Sophie L: Runbook rehearsal note — please bring a test partner tenant and a fresh API key. We'll simulate a promo redemption and a deployment rollback.

Amy C: Great. Owners: Landing page - Lisa, SI readiness - Raj, Legal badge - Legal-Jane, Press - Sophie, Blog final - Mark. If anyone can't hit these, call it out now. :thumbsup:

Raj P: Ack. I'll ping eng-sso and post updates in this thread.

Legal-Jane: I'll post the badge review result in thread by 4pm PT.

PressOps Bot: Embargo set. If embargo lifted early, notify #partnerships and #marketing immediately.

Amy C: Thanks everyone — will run checklist at 9am PT tomorrow and post final preflight here.
